content.short: Create token gates instantly to distribute exclusive content or send physical products to your token holders.
content.description: VAULT3 is a token-gating solution that allows Cardano projects and creators to easily and instantly launch custom token gates. This infrastructure can be used to distribute exclusive content to token holders, or to securely collect delivery addresses to send physical products. Our customizable access rules include FTs, NFTs, stake pools, wallet whitelists, and more. You can leverage our token gates to connect with your investors, reward your community, and boost your growth.
content.meta: Find out about VAULT3 on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
